name: AUM Namah Kala Bhairavaya
meaning: I offer salutations to Kala Bhairava, the fierce form associated with time and transformation.
purpose: A devotional salutation to Kala Bhairava, included in the Sunday section of the client list.
supports: Facing change; courage; awareness of time; personal boundaries.
when: During a contemplative practice focused on time, change and courage.
note: The longer line in the client list is a particular circulated formula; this short form is a simple nama-style salutation.
supplied: Aum Namah Kaala Bhairavaya Shree Rudra Bhairava Mahadeva Jaya Jaya Bhairava Bhairava Swaha
